title: US Blindsided: China Just Cut Off Oil Exports - Trump Makes EVERYTHING WORSE
speaker: Sean Foo

macro_themes.view: Brent above $100; China buying more crude and cancelling fuel exports, Asian backwardation; G7 reserve releases look bad by winter.
French 10-year nearing 5%, OAT-Bund spread 145bp; Japanese funds exiting.
Tokyo signalling the yen will strengthen; carry-trade unwind risk.
Trump endorsing inflation to pay off debt; dollar and bondholders face debasement.
$10T of Treasuries to refinance in 12 months at higher rates; yields to keep rising.

calls.reason: China hoarding crude and refined fuel, Hormuz disruption and depleting reserves into winter tighten supply.
calls.quote: if oil prices continue rising or just stay elevated, draining strategic stock piles now is going to look very bad

calls.reason: Can't keep issuing bonds without yields flying higher; refinancing wall and deficits.
calls.quote: Trump simply cannot keep issuing more bonds without yields flying even higher than they already are

calls.reason: Policy of inflating debt away and pressure on Fed to cut both debase the dollar.
calls.quote: The only trick remaining is to debase the dollar and transfer wealth away from bond holders through inflation

calls.reason: Tokyo told Trump the yen will strengthen; Japanese money repatriating to JGBs.
calls.quote: Tokyo just told Trump directly the yen is going to strengthen regardless of what Washington wants

notes: No date stated; listing date used. USDJPY bearish = yen bullish (outside canonical list). Brent quoted rather than WTI.
